name: Going, Going, Guano!
summary: Master Apothecary Faranell seeks guano from the Kraul Bats of Razorfen Kraul. The Royal Apothecary Society needs it for its experiments.

sections.title: A Rare Substance
sections.body: Master Apothecary Faranell oversees the Royal Apothecary Society’s alchemical work in the Undercity. He needs guano from Kraul Bats, a rare species found in Razorfen Kraul. You are asked to bring him a pile so the Society can begin its work.

faq.answer: Master Apothecary Faranell of the Royal Apothecary Society needs it for the Society’s work.
Kraul Bats are found in Razorfen Kraul.
Faranell needs it so the Royal Apothecary Society can begin its alchemical work.

faq.q: Where do I bring the guano?
faq.answer: Bring the pile of Kraul Guano to Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity.

attribution: In-game quest text: Going, Going, Guano!
